body.prompt: Photoreal industrial-design studio render of one palm-sized camera, 57 x 39 x 33 mm, concept ENTROPY: light reaching a black hole. image[1] = exact block and layout, keep it: SMALL 16 mm lens ring right of centre (a quarter of the width), flash window upper left, shutter and recessed switch on top left over the grip, USB-C and microSD on the right side. Idea ACCRETION PLATE: a thick sculpted matte black top plate is the accretion disk seen edge-on, floating over a graphite body on a recessed satin grey neck. Thick over the grip, it thins to a sharp chamfered blade toward the lens, with a half-circle bitten out above the lens ring: the disk ends where light never returns. Like a quick-release plate it carries: knurled shutter collar, slide switch in a pocket between diamond-knurled pads, two red tabs, engraved edge ticks, the charge light pipe as a green vial. image[2] = sculpted top plate floating over a dark body on a satin neck. image[3] = knurled pads, red tabs, edge scale, bubble level, cam lever. image[4] = black sphere, thin bright disk edge-on. Cam lever on the left end closing the program port, bottom vents, grip grooves front left. Rich functional surface detail, printable PLA. One camera centred on pure white, 3/4 front view slightly from above, soft light, sharp. --no text, logos, letters, numbers, screen, hands, strap, extra lenses, big lens barrel, screws
